episodes.title: Épisode 1
episodes.summary: Small-time hustlers Shaïnez and Liana land in hot water with a tough Brussels drug dealer after stealing from one of his men. Anissa asks Mehdi for help.

episodes.title: Épisode 2
episodes.summary: Mehdi and his men search for the missing drugs. Chris sends the Djeblis a warning. Impressed by Mehdi's skills, Saber blackmails him into taking a job.

episodes.title: Épisode 3
episodes.summary: As they gear up for a risky heist, Mehdi and Liana's gangs join forces. Hassan confronts Saber. Coralie reveals a terrible family secret to Sofia.

episodes.title: Épisode 4
episodes.summary: A furious Chris prepares to wage war on the Djeblis — and everyone else involved in the heist. Hassan sends Danique to cover Saber's tracks.

episodes.title: Épisode 5
episodes.summary: Mehdi tries to protect Anissa and Shaïnez. Fueled by revenge, Sofia underestimates what Chris is capable of. Liana acts carelessly.

episodes.title: Épisode 6
episodes.summary: As the war with Chris reaches a boiling point, Mehdi and Tony seek vengeance while the Djeblis plan their next move against the Antwerp enemy.

episodes.title: Épisode 1
episodes.summary: After one last heist, Mehdi arranges his affairs and prepares for Canada. The Djeblis play hardball during negotiations with new collaborators.

episodes.title: Épisode 2
episodes.summary: As Saber seeks revenge, the Los Soles cartel comes for Nahel. Commissioner Herman blackmails a captive Tony into helping her locate Mehdi.

episodes.title: Épisode 3
episodes.summary: Mehdi and Saber set the terms of their new partnership. Almeida resorts to bold measures to get intel on Mehdi when the commissioner won't budge.

episodes.title: Épisode 4
episodes.summary: Faced with fresh threats after Saber goes rogue, the gang risks everything to salvage the situation. Bad news prompts Almeida to reassess his loyalty.

episodes.title: Épisode 5
episodes.summary: After Rayane's betrayal, Mehdi, Tony and Saber pursue the stolen cocaine. Liana narrowly evades danger when the cartel traces Kelly to the workshop.

episodes.title: Épisode 6
episodes.summary: As the cartel war escalates, shocking losses send Liana and Mehdi reeling. Saber forges an unlikely alliance; Almeida's game of chess comes to an end.
